# SnapLogic Subprocessors

**Legal Notices**

**Security**

As part of our delivery of services to our SnapLogic customers, we use some third-party subprocessors. The subprocessors used to provide SnapLogic services are broken out by name of application and purpose of processing.

| **Platform subprocessors** | **Services and description of processing** | **Processing location** |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Amazon Web Services, Inc. | Cloud Service Provider | USA, EEA, Singapore, or Australia, as selected by customer |
| MongoDB, Inc. | Database Backup Management | USA or EEA |
| Cloudflare, Inc. | Content Delivery Network | USA or EEA |
| Heap, Inc. | User Experience Analytics | USA |
| Datadog, Inc. | Cloud Monitoring Software | USA or EEA |
| Grafana, Inc. | Cloud Monitoring Software | USA or EEA |
| Anthropic PBC | AI Data Processing | USA |
| Open AI, Inc. | AI Data Processing | USA |
| Google, LLC | AI Data Processing | USA |
| Azure Open AI | AI Data Processing | USA |

| **Subsidiary Companies** | **Location** |
| --- | --- |
| SnapLogic UK Limited | United Kingdom |
| SnapLogic (Thailand) Limited | Thailand |
| SnapLogic PTY Ltd | Australia |

For more details on SnapLogic Privacy, see our [Privacy Policy](https://www.snaplogic.com/privacy-policy).

If you have any questions regarding our privacy practices or this page, you can contact SnapLogic’s Data Protection Officer at [privacy@snaplogic.com](mailto:privacy@snaplogic.com).
